name: Online Lyrics
author: Penguin Player
description: Finds lyrics on LRCLIB for songs that have none of their own, or better ones if you prefer, when you open them in Now Playing.
privacy: Only the title and artist of songs are sent, and only when you open their lyrics. Unless you prefer online lyrics, that’s only for songs without lyrics of their own.

settings.title: Prefer Online Lyrics
settings.subtitle: Over songs’ own lyrics. Timed lyrics always win over untimed ones.

settings.subtitle: Show plain lyrics when no timed ones are found
